heard: From the tribe of Benjamin, paltry son of Laphut, sent by Moses from the wilderness of Paran. One leader chosen from each ancestral line, to scout the land of Canaan divine. See what the land is like, strong or weak Are their towns open camps or fortified peaks Is the soil rich or poor, trees on it or not Be bold and bring back the fruit, the lot, the lot They went up from Zin as far as Rehob Near Lebohamoth tested the path 40 days they travel through the land And return
